title_en: Koreans Ask Your Age Before Your Name 🥢 #shorts
description_en: Age decides your words, your titles, and who pays for dinner. Learn 몇 살이에요? (how old are you?), 형/언니 (older brother/sister) and 형이 쏜다 (the older one pays). Stock footage: Pexels (free license)
hook_en: Why do Koreans ask your age?
hook_vi: Vì sao người Hàn hỏi tuổi bạn?

scenes.en: How old are you? Asked in minute one.
